meta.sourceDocument: Salesforce Data Cloud Platform Services Rate Sheet

internalDataPipeline.label: Internal Data Pipeline
internalDataPipeline.tooltip: Ingestion from Salesforce Core. Rate: 0 cr / 1M Rows Processed (Prod) - 0 cr (SBX).

externalBatchIngestion.label: External Data Pipeline - Batch Ingestion
externalBatchIngestion.tooltip: Batch ingestion (S3/Snowflake/DB/REST). Rate: 2,000 cr / 1M Rows Processed (Prod) - 1,600 cr (SBX).

externalStreamingIngestion.label: External Data Pipeline - Streaming Ingestion
externalStreamingIngestion.tooltip: Real-time ingestion (Incremental only). Rate: 5,000 cr / 1M Rows Processed (Prod) - 4,000 cr (SBX).

batchDataTransforms.label: Batch Data Transforms
batchDataTransforms.tooltip: DLO to DMO batch transforms. Rate: 400 cr / 1M Rows Processed (Prod) - 320 cr (SBX).

streamingDataTransforms.label: Streaming Data Transforms
streamingDataTransforms.tooltip: Continuous transforms (Incremental only). Rate: 5,000 cr / 1M Rows Processed (Prod) - 4,000 cr (SBX).

unstructuredDataProcessed.label: Unstructured Data Processed
unstructuredDataProcessed.tooltip: PDFs/images/audio/video. Rate: 60 cr / 1 MB Processed (Prod) - 48 cr (SBX).

dataFederationRows.label: Data Federation Rows Accessed
dataFederationRows.tooltip: Zero-copy access to external lakehouse. Rate: 70 cr / 1M Rows Accessed (Prod) - 56 cr (SBX).

dataShareRowsOut.label: Data Share Rows Shared (Out)
dataShareRowsOut.tooltip: Rows shared out (Incremental only). Rate: 800 cr / 1M Rows Shared (Prod) - 640 cr (SBX).

privateConnectGB.label: Private Connect Data Processed
privateConnectGB.tooltip: PrivateLink / Private Endpoint. Rate: 500 cr / 1 GB Processed (Prod) - 400 cr (SBX).

profileUnification.label: Profile Unification (Identity Resolution)
profileUnification.tooltip: Highest-cost item. Rate: 100,000 cr / 1M Rows Processed (Prod) - 80,000 cr (SBX).

matchReconRules.label: Match & Reconciliation Rule Executions
matchReconRules.tooltip: Rulesets executed across unified population. Rate: 5,000 cr / 1M Rule Executions (Prod) - 4,000 cr (SBX).

realtimeEvents.label: Sub-second Real-Time Events
realtimeEvents.tooltip: HIGH cost. Incremental only. Rate: 70,000 cr / 1M combined Events/API/Actions (Prod) - 56,000 cr (SBX).

calculatedInsightsBatch.label: Calculated Insights - Batch
calculatedInsightsBatch.tooltip: Scheduled aggregations (LTV, RFM). Rate: 15 cr / 1M Rows Processed (Prod) - 12 cr (SBX).

calculatedInsightsStreaming.label: Calculated Insights - Streaming
calculatedInsightsStreaming.tooltip: Continuously recomputed (Incremental only). Rate: 800 cr / 1M Rows Processed (Prod) - 640 cr (SBX).

inferences.label: Inferences (AI/ML)
inferences.tooltip: ML model invocations. Rate: 3,500 cr / 1M Inferences (Prod) - 2,800 cr (SBX).

dataQueries.label: Data Queries
dataQueries.tooltip: Live queries (Incremental only). Rate: 2 cr / 1M Rows Processed (Prod) - 1.6 cr (SBX).

streamingActions.label: Streaming Actions (incl. Lookups)
streamingActions.tooltip: Real-time actions (Incremental only). Rate: 800 cr / 1M Rows Processed (Prod) - 640 cr (SBX).

segmentRowsProcessed.label: Segment Rows Processed
segmentRowsProcessed.tooltip: Rows evaluated for segment membership (Incremental only). Rate: 20 cr / 1M Rows Processed (Prod) - 16 cr (SBX).

batchActivation.label: Batch Activation (with or without related attributes)
batchActivation.tooltip: Audience push (Incremental only). Rate: 10 cr / 1M Rows Processed (Prod) - 8 cr (SBX).

streamingActivation.label: Activate DMO - Streaming
streamingActivation.tooltip: Continuous streaming activation (Incremental only). Rate: 1,600 cr / 1M Rows Processed (Prod) - 1,280 cr (SBX).
